none: PAS NLM-68E416: Post-Medeieval Commemorative Medal of Victoria
contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy Medal. Pressed metal commemorative medal celebrating the diamond jubilee of Queen Victoria (1897), of concavo-convex form. On the obverse a legend in Roman capitals is carried horizontally over the arms of a Maltese cross with a cushion crown and the date: 18 97 in a central oval panel, all on a plain ground. The obverse [convex side] legend reads: TO COMMEMORATE/THE//60th/YEAR/OF…
